notes.title: Dev Diary #4 - A Peek at the Next Update!
notes.content:
Hello Mages!

We're back with another Dev Diary!

First to know, instead of releasing one large update, we've decided to break these features (that we have teased in our latest blog) into multiple patches/updates. We are currently working on three (and possibly four) key features that will be added to Revenge of the Mage soon: Steam Achievements, the Talent System, Voice Acting (and Leaderboards). These features are designed to enhance long-term goals and player progression, as well as to elevate the game's storytelling.  


Achievements

We are currently testing Steam Achievements to give you specific milestones to work toward. We’ve designed a variety of achievements that track different accomplishments in the game. Some will be tied to general progression, while others are designed for specific, challenging tasks.

These achievements are intended to add a new layer of goals and replayability for those who enjoy chasing them. As a starting point, we have planned a specific list of achievements. Here are some of the Achievements to give you an idea.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8d407f762f5d3daa360c7204c9d291ca33009878.png"]


But over time, we want to expand the list bit by bit. We believe this will be especially fun for the Achievement Hunters out there to come back and claim them.


The Talent System

To address the desire for more lasting progression between runs, we are adding another feature to our meta-progression system: The Ancestral Talent Board, which we had mentioned in our second blog.

This is a well-known skill tree where you can spend your skill points to permanently improve your character. You'll gain these points when you level up (yeah, big surprise :P). The talents will offer a range of upgrades, from increasing your core stats to unlocking new passive abilities or modifying existing ones. It's still under heavy construction, but you can see two versions of the concept design for the Ancestral Talent Board here. And yes, there are Ascendency nodes at the top of the second concept ;)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/008aee277a431116f4adc19c4a077be38235cfcd.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/bbe7e43634a3577d47a8e94608ea032fdf7366c4.png"]
We are going back and forth on these concepts and the system itself while testing to find out what would be the best fit for Revenge of the Mage. Once a decision is made, we'll provide more details about how this feature will be introduced later. But eventually, this system is going to be a designed to provide a tangible sense of growth and a reward for your time spent playing, regardless of how far you get in a single run. The choices you make in the Talent System will allow you to customize your build over time, offering new strategic options for future runs. 


Voice Acting

To truly bring their personalities to life, we're adding voice acting for the player character and the Wizard Cat. This is just the beginning of our voiced characters feature for Revenge of the Mage, designed to elevate the game's storytelling and humor and help you get to know these two heroes on a whole new level. 


Leaderboards

For those of you who love a good competition, we are looking to include Leaderboards in the next update. We'll use Steam's leaderboard infrastructure for this. The plan is to track a variety of metrics, such as your highest score in a run and your fastest time to defeat a boss. This feature is all about friendly competition and seeing how your skills stack up against other mages and your friends. We're planning to introduce several leaderboards to give everyone a chance to climb to the top, regardless of their preferred playstyle.


Optimization & Performance Issues
We are aware that some mages faced frame drops and stuttering, particularly in specific multiverses. There are also a couple of crash scenarios that we are investigating. We are aiming to address all of these by the next update.

That’s it for this diary— we’re incredibly excited for what’s ahead, and we’re thankful to have such a supportive and passionate community with us on this journey. As always, your feedback means everything, so keep it coming!  

Until next time; 

— The Revenge of the Mage DEV Team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png"]

notes.title: Dev Diary #3 - The New Game Mode & More
notes.content:
Hello Mages!

We're back with another Dev Diary to talk about the future of Revenge of the Mage. First of all, we want to thank each and every one of you who played the game, shared feedback, wrote reviews, and supported us throughout this journey. Your input has been incredibly valuable, and we’ve been carefully analyzing everything you’ve said since the day we launched.

Over time, a few recurring themes stood out in the feedback we've received. We want to take this opportunity to acknowledge those points, share our thoughts, and give you a clearer picture of how we’re planning to address them in the coming updates.

Most Mentioned Topics Since the Start of Early Access
Repetitive Gameplay & Lack of Content Variety

One of the most common pieces of feedback has been that the gameplay loop feels repetitive. Many players noted that missions tend to follow a similar structure and that the design doesn’t offer enough variety to keep things feeling fresh over time. We hear you loud and clear.


 A new Game Mode: ”Darkest Deep” (Endless Arena) that plays differently from the current ones. Each run will feature unique encounters with enemies and bosses from all multiverses. This is a mid-sized arena fight that only ends if the player dies. Players have to survive as long as they can. After entering the Darkest Deep player has to take the light source to start the fight. The max range of the visibility is limited, the arena has a dim light, and the only bright light source is the player himself. It’s hard to see the edge of the arena. Players can increase the radius of the light they carry, but in time, the light will diminish and return to its base value. We will introduce more details for this game mode later.
 We also plan to include a leaderboard to track top performers.
 Introducing new enemy types over time to keep gameplay dynamic for all Multiverses. These will be rolled out in regular updates as they’re completed, rather than bundled into large, infrequent patches.
 Balancing the Cards, Power-Ups, Difficulty, Leveling, and Currencies will continue with the feedback.


Optimization & Performance Issues

We know performance has been a concern. Frame drops and stuttering have affected the experience for some players, particularly in specific multiverses.


 We’re actively working on optimization and will continue to roll out performance-focused updates to improve stability across all supported hardware.
 The Forest multiverse had the most noticeable performance issues at launch. We’ve already addressed many of them in previous patches. This same deep-dive process will continue for each multiverse to ensure a smooth, stable experience overall.


Weak Storytelling & Lore
Players have been asking for a deeper narrative and stronger world-building. The current storytelling has been seen as too shallow to sustain long-term engagement. That’s fair — and to be honest, during the early stages of Early Access, we intentionally focused more on core gameplay first. But now, the time has come to bring the story into the spotlight.


 Our most recent patch focused on improving cinematics and immersion. All boss encounters will now include intro cutscenes, and we’ll continue filling in the missing scenes across multiverses.
 We’re planning to expand environmental storytelling to make the worlds feel more alive and detailed.
 We’ll add flavor text to cards, spells, items, and Ancestors to help deepen the lore and give players more insight into the story.


More on the Horizon

In addition to the key topics above, we have many more features and improvements in the works, but these are probably getting the priority:


 Achievements – For those who want to chase every goal and collect everything.
 Leaderboards – Compete and compare your best runs with others.
 Ancestral Talent Board – Expand your build possibilities and customization. Here you can see the concept design of Ancestral Talent Board; the details about this feature will be introduced later.
 Smuggler – A mysterious new character who can secure your goods before you fall and lose them. The Smuggler will appear randomly during runs. Interacting with him will pause the game — you’ll be able to hand over items you want to protect, and then he’ll vanish. You’ll find him later at The Safe Haven (HUB), where you can reclaim the items he safeguarded.
 Shop Vendor – A new zone featuring a vendor who offers valuable goods and services in exchange for your hard-earned gold and other currencies. It's a place to stock up, trade, and make choices that could influence your run.
 Shrines of Magic – Shrines will appear randomly on the level, or maybe not. Upon interaction and purchase, the player will have a chance to receive a Random Card, Power-Up, or Temporary Upgrade until the boss is defeated. There will be a base gold cost, and it will increase by 25% with each activation. And will be activated for a limited number of times. There is a chance of not getting any reward.
 Destructibles – To add more interaction and chaos to the environment.
 Tutorial Level – To better onboard new players into the game systems.
 Deck Building – Unlock new cards to use them in multiverses.


That’s it for this diary— we’re incredibly excited for what’s ahead, and we’re thankful to have such a supportive and passionate community with us on this journey. As always, your feedback means everything, so keep it coming! 

Our renewed Roadmap is here

Until next time;

 — The Revenge of the Mage DEV Team

notes.title: Patch v0.0.1.172 is Live!
notes.content:
Greetings Mages!

Since our first major update, we’ve made several quality-of-life improvements and gameplay adjustments based on your feedback. This patch focuses on refining mechanics, balancing spells, and enhancing the overall experience. Here’s what’s new:

Steam Cloud

 Integrated Steam Cloud: We've prioritized Steam Cloud integration based on community requests and moved it up in our roadmap. Now, our dear Mages can sync their saves seamlessly!
Before syncing Steam Cloud, we recommend backing up your files just in case. This will allow you to recover them if any errors occur with Steam Cloud. 

Save Files Location: AppData/Local/RevengeOfTheMage\Saved\SaveGames

Gameplay Changes

 Energy Detonation: We’ve received feedback about the ability and immediately revised it.


 Lowered the animation sound volume.
 Increased the effect area: 1.75m → 2.50m
 Increased the cooldown to balance the effect: 2s → 4s
 Distinct Power-ups: Power-ups now always spawn as distinct types, preventing duplicates.

 Trap Spawning: Traps no longer spawn beneath the player at the start of the Pyramid Boss Fight.

Bug Fixes

 Cathedral Enemies Stuck: Enemies no longer get stuck on one of the nails in the Cathedral Multiverse’s center area.

 Cathedral Nails: Thanks to a community report, we fixed one of the nails in the Cathedral Multiverse that dealt unintended damage.

 Teleport Back Locations: Thanks to another community report, we fixed an issue where players would get stuck when teleporting back to the surface from off the map. Teleport locations for the Tokyo and Cathedral Multiverses have been updated.


Optimization

 Forest Multiverse: To improve performance, we’ve temporarily removed towers and optimized enemies. In our internal tests though results may vary by system, this increased performance by an average of 20 FPS. This is not a permanent fix but will enhance the experience until a full solution is implemented.


Localization Fixes

 Fixes for All Languages: Since the Major Update we've revised localizations in all languages.


The Wizard Cat

 Audio: The cat now purrs when petted—voiced by one of the dev team’s own cats! 😺


We appreciate your feedback and hope you enjoy the changes! Let us know if you run into any issues.

Happy casting!

—The Dev Team

notes.title: Unleash The Storm Major Update is live!
notes.content:
Hello Mages!

We’re thrilled to release our first major free update for Revenge of the Mage! This update introduces the brand-new Lightning Archetype, a Ring Crafting & Equipping system, a General Progression Level system, and plenty of gameplay improvements, balance tweaks, and bug fixes.

Dev Note: We invite you to test this major patch and share your thoughts on the new features. Two days after the update, we’ll begin adjusting costs and gameplay balance based on your feedback. In the meantime, we’ll keep you updated with Steam Announcements & Discussions. You can also reach us in a heartbeat :) on our Discord server! 

[hr][/hr]

Summary

For those who prefer a quick rundown, here’s what’s new!


 Pet the Wizard Cat! – Yes! As you requested, you can now pet the Wizard Cat! :)
 New Archetype: Lightning – Command the power of storms!
 New Combo Gauge System: Keep fighting to deal even more damage!
 New Crafting System: Start crafting powerful rings.
 General Progression Level System: Play more, progress more.
 Gameplay Changes: Scaling Difficulty tweaks, balance adjustments, and more.
 Tons of bug fixes: We’ve squashed a lot of them!


[hr][/hr]

Pet the Wizard Cat!

Do we even need to say more? :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/64ff0058ff968a4ec06e467f1fcca8529af40dca.gif

[hr][/hr]

Lightning Archetype

Our first (but definitely not the last!) additional Archetype has arrived – and it’s electrifying!
Unleash the raw power of lightning to strike down your foes with devastating energy-based attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/24edf3bc739c81b840d76db4b046596ec9a8c81a.gif

[hr][/hr]

New Combo Gauge System

Introducing the Combo Gauge System! Your primary ability damage now scales with your combo rank.
This means enemies will feel less like bullet sponges if you stay in combat and maintain your momentum—the longer you fight, the harder you hit!

Additionally, we’ve made some adjustments to enemy health pools for better balance.

[previewyoutube=FZoWBawbLc8;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

Crafting System

Crafting is finally here, starting with rings!

To craft and upgrade these unique magical accessories, follow these steps:


 Reach the required Progression Level to unlock them.
 Collect Gem Crystals scattered across the multiverse.
 Break Gem Crystals to obtain Gems.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/ca82b5cdb99cef1e94e8bc198fd26d8642fe1716.gif

 Use Gems and Gold to Craft or Upgrade a ring.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/f08c4505f88c3de0e3d6e209d479d94a84e5190b.gif

 Equip your rings and enjoy their special effects!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/d819614db04f0877de613b4c91e4e0713db25be8.gif

For example, let's look at two rings. These rings modify the Draw The Line and Holy Ground cards. Normally, these cards create zones that provide movement speed and healing. However, when the rings are worn, these zones transform into auras surrounding the mage. This effect allows mages to maintain their momentum in battle without being restricted to specific areas.

Ring of the Moonwalker for altering the Draw The Line Card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/1e762a754292616d6bb2401d24c29df80344c40a.gif

Ring of Medic for altering the Holy Ground Card
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/7c86ada88cb4df4f90873c388e8336618d938148.gif


[hr][/hr]

General Progression Level System

To create a smoother and more rewarding experience, we’ve introduced the General Progression Level System.

Dev Note: For now, only Rings can be unlocked with this system, but in the future, many more features will be integrated into it.

For example, a player can increase their Progression Level to 10 if they play on Medium initial difficulty with consecutive Multiverse runs (Multiverse 1 > M2 > M3 > M4 > M5, then looping back to M1 and completing it successfully), which takes approximately 1 hour.

There is no XP penalty for Progression Level if the player dies.

For now, we believe this is a fair balance. Of course, this is not the final decision—we will continue refining these values based on your feedback, as we always have.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/321a2144247a05766036c72295d272f06214b36e.gif

We want every battle and upgrade to feel meaningful in the long run!

How do you level up? Just play! :)

[hr][/hr]

Gameplay Changes & Bug Fixes


 We made a significant change for how often Scaling Difficulty increases.
 Boss health pools have been reworked – Since difficulty scaling now applies, we’ve reduced their base health for better balance.
 Primary abilities of all Archetypes have been adjusted – This change is driven by the revised Permanent Upgrade Moar Powwa, which now grants +10 base damage per rank instead of +5. Additionally, auto-targeting abilities now deal slightly less damage to maintain balance with aim-required abilities.
 The new Combo Gauge System now boosts primary ability damage as your combo rank increases.
 Enemy Hit Outline: Reduced the duration of enemy hit outlines for a sharper hit response.
 Effects after Boss Defeat: Poison areas are now removed after the boss is defeated.
 AoE Ability Visuals: For AOE spells decal areas increased 30% to match better with collision area.
 Piercing Projectiles: Now piercing projectiles pierce through shields.
 Description Revisions: Revised ability descriptions to match their in-game representation.
 Gold to Recover: In the portal interaction window "Gold at Risk" has been changed to "Gold to Recover" for better clarity.
 Portal Locations in Safe Heaven: Swapped the locations of the Tokyo and Forest Portals in the HUB to match the unlock order.
 Pause Menu: Pause menu not showing when return to hub/menu or quit widgets closed with esc fixed.
 Chest Pickup SFX: Chest pickup sound not playing fix.
 Passive Spell Cards on Pause: Passive spell card animations now properly pause when the game is paused.
 Drone Health Bar: Fixed drone health bar position being too high.
 Enemy Outline: Enemy hit outlines now appear in the North and Tokyo multiverses.


[hr][/hr]

Language Support
Portuguese: Introduced Portuguese (Brazil) localization to make the game accessible for more mages.

[hr][/hr]

Also, we’ve updated our roadmap! Check it out here.

[hr][/hr]

We’re always grateful for your feedback and excited to see how these changes improve your experience. Stay tuned for more updates and as always let us know if you encounter any issues!

May the magic be with you!

-The Dev Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - More details for Lightning, Crafting & Progression System!
notes.content:
Hello Mages!

We’re back with another diary about the progress and adjustments of our most exciting upcoming features. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’ve been hard at work refining every detail. Here’s what’s new:

An Electrifying Progress
The Lightning Mage has undergone a significant transformation since our last dev diary. We've fine-tuned every ability and reworked some to deliver the ultimate gameplay experience. Before diving into the details, here is a video showing what we’ve brewed. (Dev Note: WE’RE EXCITED!)

[previewyoutube=3FvK_nMxs2Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Let’s go deeper!

We've updated related visuals to emphasize the lightning theme to have a yellow, electrifying color. We also worked hard on hand animations to create a dynamic look that matches the casted spell. Here are two gifs from before and after the visual updates.

BEFORE
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/7787cdff9f9af598a31e7a9dafa83216d67cf668.gif
CURRENT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/7be7d352b843aba9e9580761687c7be33c6041fd.gif

Abilities of the Lightning Mage focuses on fast-paced combat and area control. Shock effect is one of the key elements for this archetype. Some abilities shock enemies and shock deals consecutive damage while active. This creates strategic opportunities to manipulate enemy movements and funnel hordes into zones where your burst damage can wipe them out. 

Here is an example of how the abilities can be combined to maximize their impact.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/ba0b29fab1371cbd32db34d5ad495f1f29a93957.gif

This archetype stands out not only in rapid damage but also in quick movement. If used wisely, movement abilities can become powerful tools against enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/e9c68f1181612a708fcdaf87b8747143d84acdb6.gif

Gems, Gems, Gems!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/a707ea7d00d657a48313e79823034b14bde52a09.png
We elaborated on the Ring Crafting system in the last dev diary. We mentioned Gems there, now let’s talk about them in detail. Gems are obtained from multiverses and used for crafting purposes. You’ll find Gems by breaking Gem Crystals. We’ll improve the experience by enhancing the visual and audio effects for satisfying crystal breaking. 


 Each multiverse has Common Gems, which determines the most frequently found Gem Types.
 Gems can be collected by moving over them after breaking Gem Crystals.
 Gem Crystals can be found in certain spots when you enter a multiverse. 
 The number of Gem Crystals and the Gems they drop increase with your base difficulty level.
 Collected Gems are added directly to your inventory and are not lost if you fall in battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/ca82b5cdb99cef1e94e8bc198fd26d8642fe1716.gif

Let’s see some rings!
Now that we’ve talked about Gems, let’s move on to rings! We have some clear visual examples to portray how they’re going to affect gameplay.

For example, let's look at two rings. These rings modify the Draw The Line and Holy Ground cards. Normally, these cards create zones that provide movement speed and healing. However, when the rings are worn, these zones transform into auras surrounding the mage. This effect allows mages to maintain their momentum in battle without being restricted to specific areas.

Movement Ring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/1e762a754292616d6bb2401d24c29df80344c40a.gif

Health Ring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/7c86ada88cb4df4f90873c388e8336618d938148.gif

Account Progression
We are currently in the process of creating the Account Progression system, and we’ll be sharing more visual details soon!

As you gain Account Level XP through multiverses, you'll unlock new features like new rings to craft and other exciting enhancements. Stay tuned for more updates!


Dev Note: We're not big fans of resetting player progression. Some games do this during Early Access, and while we understand the reasoning as both developers and players, we prefer to avoid it. However, with the introduction of the new general progression (leveling) system, we may have to reset all player progress so far.

That said... brace yourselves.


Fixes & Changes on the next patch
Beyond these major additions, we're also focusing on smaller updates to enhance your gameplay. Some of these are quality-of-life tweaks that are designed to deliver a more polished and immersive game feel. Let’s look into some topics you’ll see in our next patch:


 Ability Updates: We revised some abilities to make them more impactful.

 AoE Visuals: We’ll increase decal size by 30% to show their effect area accurately.
 Piercing Projectiles: Previously, these projectiles only passed through enemies. Now, they will also penetrate shields Which will significantly enhance their effectiveness.

 Boss Difficulty: Boss HP and damage will be adjusted with your scaling difficulty, with bosses receiving a slightly larger boost than other enemies. This will ensure a fair challenge, especially during consecutive runs.

 Description Revisions: We're updating descriptions to improve clarity and consistency. We want to ensure they accurately reflect their in-game representations.

 Bug Fixes: There will be several fixes which are focused on delivering a smoother gameplay.

Pause Menu: It will properly appear when returning to the Safe Heaven or closing menus with Esc.
Chest Pickup SFX: There is a fix for chest pickup sound not playing.
Passive Spell Cards: UI animations are going to correctly pause when the game is paused.

 Of course, there’s more to come! But these are some key areas we wanted to highlight for now. 


May the magic be with you!
-The Dev Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

notes.title: RoTM - Unleash The Storm! Dev Diary
notes.content:
Before we get into the details of the first update of the game, another patch with more fixes is coming in a few days. We wanted to gather as much as possible before releasing it, rather than pushing rapid patches.

Now, let's talk about the the update!

A Sneak Peek at What’s Next!
Well, beyond fixes and adjustments we’ve been brewing something magical behind the scenes. We are currently focusing on 3 main features.

The Mighty Lightning Archetype
Yes! Our electrifying mage is coming together. We’re working to make it feel like you are the one bringing down the bolts. This lightning-wielding spellcaster dominates the battlefield with devastating bursts of electricity, chaining attacks between enemies and summoning storms to obliterate foes.

We can't imagine a Lightning Mage without a Chain Lightning spell! Chain Lightning arcs between multiple foes, unleashing twin bolts that leap across the battlefield. Send shocking orbs that zap targets one by one, or hurl a massive lightning ball rolling through enemies before detonating in a thunderous explosion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/94f3c5996e3d761ed1f4d70a909f1f729b736888.gif

Need some Crowd Control? Cast an electrical zone that traps and stuns / damages enemies in a storm of energy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/c446d743e7ba0cceac9b5ec808b4038242a01675.gif

Strike with precision using a piercing lightning beam, fire a thunderous arrow that carves through anything in its path, or dash forward as spears of lightning rain from the sky!

DEV Note: These animations and VFXs will be updated. So, we’re always testing and iterating to meet your expectations. For more appealing visuals, 

Ring Crafting

This Ring Crafting will be just the beginning of the Crafting System in RoTM!

Let’s do some crafting! 
This system lets you gather Gems across different maps and use them to craft some powerful rings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/a707ea7d00d657a48313e79823034b14bde52a09.png

Then, you'll wear them to unleash your true potential. But you might be wondering, "What powers do these rings hold?"

Well, here’s a glimpse at what we have in mind;

Each ring offers unique advantages—at a price.

Some grant a second chance at survival, either teleporting you back to safety or leaving you on the brink of death with a fleeting escape portal. Others reshape combat and economy, like one that boosts gold gain at the cost of damage, or another that sacrifices gold for raw power.

For those who embrace risk, certain rings push the limits—one fuels your ultimate with your own life force for increased devastation, while another triggers a random ultimate from any archetype whenever you unleash your own.

Tactical players will find rings that enhance potion effectiveness, strengthen card-based synergies, or even cause projectiles to chain between multiple enemies.

Whether you crave power, adaptability, or high-stakes strategies, these rings will let you forge your own path to dominance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/b76ee805a6bdd899bc213ab22375fdd935c0af1f.gif

And of course, to show off your rings across the multiverse, we’re planning to add 3D models so you can inspect and admire their power up close!


How does it work?
There are different types of Gems and they can be acquired in specific maps. Explore the maps and find Gem Crystals scattered across different locations. When you destroy a Gem Crystal, it will drop Gems for you. These Gems are required for Crafting or Upgrading a Ring. When you are in the crafting panel, you will see the rings with unique effects. Crafting or Upgrading requires Gems and Gold. When you craft a ring you will wear it on your fingers.


 Find Gem Crystal across the multiverse.
 Destroy a Gem Crystal to acquire Gems.
 Use Gems and Gold to Craft or Upgrade a ring.
 Wear your rings to enjoy their unique effects.


New Combo Gauge System

Momentum is Power – Keep Fighting, Keep Hitting Harder!

According to your feedback and our internal tests, while primary abilities are quite useful at the start, they tend to become just a tool to trim some health from enemies as the difficulty increases. We came up with a system to both solve this situation and create an engaging feature for you.

Our current Combo Gauge Rank System:
There is currently a rank system tied to your continuous engagement in combat. You can see it in the bottom-left corner of your screen, and it increases as you unleash chaos upon enemies. The rank resets when you're out of combat for a while, but your highest rank is recorded. To add more depth and address the trimming issue, we've revised this system.

[previewyoutube=FZoWBawbLc8;full][/previewyoutube]

How does the new Combo Gauge System work?
Now, your primary ability damage scales with your combo rank. As long as you stay in combat, your attacks grow stronger, ensuring that even as the difficulty rises, your primary ability remains a force to be reckoned with. So yes, momentum is your new power—keep the fight going and watch your damage soar!


 Engage in combat and get your rank up.
 You will get a bonus primary ability damage according to your new rank.
 If you stay away from a fight for a while, your rank resets and you lose your primary ability bonus


As we continue to develop these features, we will be sharing our progress with you. Feel free to share your valuable feedback on our Discord Server.

May the magic be with you!
-The Dev Team
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

notes.title: Reflecting on Our Journey Since Early Access Launch
notes.content:
Hello Mages!

As we released the demo version of our game, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on the journey we've shared since the early access launch. Your incredible feedback and support have been the driving force behind every decision we’ve made, and we’ve learned a lot along the way.


[code]Before diving into the details, we’d like to kindly recommend ensuring your graphics drivers are up to date for the smoothest and most magical experience. A quick update can make a world of difference in performance and visual quality.
[/code]

Challenges We’ve Faced

Optimization and Stability:

 Creating a visually detailed world with fluid performance was one of our biggest challenges. Reports from our community pushed us to improve stability, and we’ve made significant progress.

Gameplay Refinements:

 Adapting gameplay elements to player feedback to enhance the overall experience was one of our key focuses. 

Expanding Audience:

 We focused on making the game accessible to a wider audience. We improved UI readability, added language support, and offered control customizations.



Key Improvements

Bug Fixes and Stability Enhancements:

 Persistent crash issues have been significantly reduced.
 Optimization efforts have made the game more stable across a variety of systems.

AI Behavior:

 Enemy behaviors were refined to make combat more dynamic and strategic.
 Ranged enemies and horde systems now behave more consistently.

Gameplay Improvements:

 We refined gameplay elements to enhance pacing and provide a more fluid experience.
 Auto-targeting systems were refined to prioritize critical threats during combat.

UI and UX Updates:

 Fonts and card descriptions were adjusted for better readability.
 Improvements to user experience, such as confirmation prompts and enhanced navigation clarity.
 Default settings were adjusted to improve the first-time experience for new players.

Optimizations Across the Board:

 We’ve made performance improvements to VFX and maps to deliver smoother gameplay. Even on systems meeting the minimum requirements.

Customization for Controls:

 We added detailed customization for controls.
 Added gamepad aim to assist customization to improve accessibility.

Expanding Language Support:

 We added Russian and Chinese language options to welcome more players.


The Demo
With all the progress made since early access, we’re excited to share the demo version of the game! This demo encapsulates everything we’ve learned and improved upon so far. It’s designed to give new players a taste of the magic.

Looking Ahead
This is just the beginning. We’re eager to expand the game with new features and refine the gameplay even further. Your feedback will continue to shape the game as we prepare for full release. Thank you for being with us every step of the way. We couldn’t have come this far without your passion and support. As always, we’re here to listen, learn and improve.

Roadmap
You can find more details in our updated Roadmap.

Happy casting,

—The Dev Team

notes.title: New Patch is Cooking! & A Glimpse for Feature Updates!
notes.content:
Hello, Mages!

We’ve been gathering tons of valuable feedback from you and are working hard to address the issues you’ve reported. The next patch is approximately two days away, may less! (Fingers crossed!)

We’re also updating our >>>Roadmap<<< and will continue to keep it as up-to-date as possible.

Improving Overall Performance
Performance has been the strongest area of feedback we’ve received. The upcoming patch will include a significant number of performance improvements. Of course, you can expect even more improvements in future planned updates as we optimize the game.

Crashes
While we’ve resolved and patched some crashes, occasional issues may still occur. We’re actively collecting your crash reports (so please hit that Send button!) and investigating the problems. Rest assured, we’re fully committed to addressing every crash in future updates.

What About the Next Patch?
We want to share details about what you can expect in the next patch! (DEV Note: These updates may be split into separate patches if needed.)

Optimization

Making improvements to optimize performance. We’re also exploring the possibility of lowering the Minimum System Requirements, but of course without losing too much visual quality. In the future, we also aim to increase the overall visual quality as much as possible. (DEV Note: This may take a few more patches to hit perfect performance.)
FSR support is one of the most frequently requested features and is on the way.


New Accessibility Features

 The Invert Mouse setting has been divided into separate horizontal and vertical options.
 Adding Invert Horizontal/Vertical settings for controllers.
 Adding settings for Gamepad Magnetism Strength and Gamepad Magnetism Radius.
 Adding more sound effects for Spell and Archetype Unlocks to improve UX.
 Adding bigger font sizes for card descriptions to improve UX. (DEV Note: This may slip to another patch, but bear with us!)


Localization
Russian and Chinese language support is on the way!

Changes & Balancing

 Reworked Glacial Step and Fiery Charge: These abilities can now pass through enemies during use.
 Reworked Meteor Storm: This ability now deals damage to airborne enemies as well.
 Reduced Meteor Storm radius from 10m to 7m. (DEV Note: Slightly nerfed.)
 Increased Meteor Strike radius from 5m to 7m. (DEV Note: Slightly buffed.)
 The Damage Area Increase card now also affects the radius of the Contagious Burn and Meteor Strike.


Bug Fixes

 Fixing an issue where key rebinds are not saved after exiting the game.
 Fixing the controller aim assist vertical issue.
 Fixing multiple ring abilities of the Mumadonna boss. Some rings are not dealing damage when moving away from the boss; they will now deal damage as intended.
 Fixing an issue where card selection sometimes does not appear.
 Fixing an issue with Arcane Missiles auto-lock not targeting shielded enemies.
 Fixing an issue where Morva the Defiler's projectile attacks bounce back even without The Mirror Mirror Card.


What’s Next? A Small Glimpse Into the Feature Updates!

Thank you all again for jumping in and slinging spells with us at the beginning of our Early Access journey with RotM!

Our team is working hard, day and night, to respond as quickly as possible to your feedback. Even though we’ve already planned a lot for RotM, your participation is what will make this game even better.

Even for a Early Access launch many find really easy and fast to complete the current game content (not necessarily unlocking everything, but generally speaking). Some players like this, but others don’t. So we’ve already started working on possible solutions to be able to balance the time and effort required to complete the game with the current content.

This might raise a question for many of you: Are we going to reset the current progress? For now, no—that’s not part of the plan.


 It's hard to see some bosses within all the chaos of combat, so we planned to add an indicator for the boss, so players may more easily track them. This feature probably will have a QoL setting in the options, for those who don't want to use it.
 When a player uses ALT+F4 or if the game crashes mid-run, players lose their hard-earned gold. We’re actively working on a solution to save your gold without breaking the high-risk, high-reward concept.
 We’ll bring more cards and permanent upgrades that can be combined with the Archetypes!
 Leaderboards, Steam Achievements, and Trading Cards are features we want to introduce as soon as possible. (And Cloud Save for Steam!)
 Deck-building is one of our priority features, so you’ll be able to choose your favorite cards and leave out the ones you don’t like.


You can find more details in our updated Roadmap.

We’d love to talk about RotM with you on our Discord, track your feedback and concerns, and hear your suggestions. So please, we encourage you to join our Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and work to improve your RotM experience. Thank you for being part of this journey.

Also, we are aware of that optimization is the most frequently reported issue, and we are continuing to work on improving it.

notes.title: Early Access Launched!
notes.content:
Revenge of the Mage has entered the Early Access phase, and we’re thrilled to share what’s coming. To celebrate, there is a launch discount. The Early Access version will feature multiple multiverses, Mage Archetypes, Spells, Cards, and Permanent Upgrades, with more content added regularly.

Game Features

In Revenge of the Mage, your journey begins in the Safe Haven (HUB), where you’ll choose from three Mage Archetypes, some unlockable with gold. (Two more Archetypes are coming soon.) The final count won’t stop at five, we have plans for more Archetypes in secret! And we’d love to hear your suggestions to add into the game! We also welcome ideas for spells, permanents, or cards.

If you are interested, here is the Roadmap that we have started filling up, in a few days more details will be revealed!

You'll also find a Permanent Upgrade Station to enhance abilities that affect all Archetypes, so you won’t have to re-unlock or upgrade for each one. But be careful—dying in a multiverse means dropping 75% of your gold. You’ll need to fight your way back to retrieve it, or it’s lost for good. After defeating a multiverse boss and securing the seed, the next portal opens for you to either return or continue the journey. We encourage you to push forward to Archmage's Doom (Very Hard Difficulty)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265547/8f42ad42a69012e8e6fb114e42d31f9dfae8e927.png

The Difficulty

Our game has two types of difficulties: initial and scaling. The initial difficulty is selected when interacting with the portal to travel to a multiverse, with four difficulty settings available. The difficulty won’t affect the first multiverse, as it’s a warm-up. Scaling difficulty increases as you progress in the game. The bar in the top right corner displays both the selected initial difficulty and the current status of the scaling difficulty. Difficulty also affects increased gain of gold but enemies will be tougher!

We’ve also started creating a RoTM Wiki, which can be accessed here. It’ll make learning the basics and uncovering secrets much easier for everyone!

You’ll notice some stations in the Safe Haven (such as the Infusion Station and Item Chest) that are not yet available in this version. We’ve kept them visible so you can see what’s coming next. These stations are not final; additional ones may be added before becoming functional.

Rogue-lite Cycle

Revenge of the Mage embraces the rogue-lite experience: live, fight, die, and repeat. Each time you return to Safe Haven, you’ll grow stronger by unlocking new abilities and upgrades, mastering the mechanics, and learning from your failures. The game encourages you to become an unstoppable force as you face increasingly tough challenges.

What’s Next?

Looking ahead, we’re working on adding Steam Achievements and Trading Cards. We’re also focused on optimizing the game for higher FPS and have added options to launch with DX11 or DX12 (though DX12 still requires fine-tuning).

As a small indie team, your feedback will be important to shape the game to its full potential before releasing it in 1.0. Therefore contents, performance, graphics, (you name it) can heavily change until we reach v1.0. And we are planning to keep RoTM at Early Access until it's called "solid" by the players.

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to see you in Revenge of the Mage!
